grammar.point: have/has for symptoms + should for advice
grammar.explanation_en: To describe a symptom, use 'have/has + a/an + symptom': 'I have a headache.' To give friendly advice, use 'should + base verb': 'You should rest.' 'Should' does not change form with the subject.
grammar.explanation_ko: 증상을 말할 때는 'have/has + a/an + 증상' 형태를 씁니다: 'I have a headache.'(저는 두통이 있어요). 다정한 조언을 할 때는 'should + 동사원형'을 씁니다: 'You should rest.'(쉬는 게 좋겠어요). should는 주어에 따라 형태가 바뀌지 않습니다.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: I have a headache and a fever.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: You should see a doctor and rest.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, I think I will go home now.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 지금 집에 가야 할 것 같아요.

reading.title: Feeling Sick
reading.text: Today, I have a headache and a stomachache. I don't feel good. My friend says I should drink warm water and rest at home. I think I have a cold. Tomorrow, I will see a doctor if I still feel bad.
reading.text_ko: 오늘 저는 두통과 복통이 있어요. 몸이 안 좋아요. 친구는 따뜻한 물을 마시고 집에서 쉬는 게 좋겠다고 해요. 감기에 걸린 것 같아요. 내일도 계속 안 좋으면 병원에 갈 거예요.

explanation.en: The text mentions a headache and a stomachache, but not a cough.
explanation.ko: 본문에는 두통과 복통만 언급되고 기침은 없습니다.

explanation.en: The text says the friend suggests drinking warm water and resting.
explanation.ko: 본문에 'drink warm water and rest at home'이라고 나옵니다.

explanation.en: The text says 'I will see a doctor if I still feel bad.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'I will see a doctor'라고 나옵니다.
